what_happened: In job wqp8, the user corrected Athena's first reading before work began. The reading put the rule for marking an item urgent into the reader prompt (reader.md). That prompt set is at 1997 of its 2000-token budget, so it cannot take more text. The user moved the rule to the reading's output schema field doc (outputs.rs) or the reader brief rendered by briefs.rs, net of anything removed, with the reader set kept within budget. Criterion 5 moves there too.
cause: The reading stage chooses where to put new instruction text from the request wording alone. It is not shown how much token budget each prompt set has left, and nothing checks the remaining room before the reading is accepted. The budgets test is the only guard, and it runs only after the producer starts. This time the user caught the problem at the reading, so no deadline was lost. The next reading is just as likely to pick the nearly full file.
prevention: Add a check at reading admission. It takes each prompt file the reading or plan says it will grow, and compares the planned growth with the remaining budget the budgets test computes. It rejects the reading, naming the file and the room left, when the growth does not fit. Also show the reader the remaining budget per prompt set, so it picks a place with room, or plans removals, before dispatch.
proposed_request: Add a pre-dispatch prompt budget check to Athena. When a reading or plan names a prompt file to grow (such as reader.md), compute that prompt set's remaining token budget with the same counting the budgets test uses (cargo test --locked -p athena-cli --test budgets). If the planned addition does not fit, refuse the reading with a message naming the file, the tokens left and the tokens needed, and tell the reading to place the text elsewhere (such as the output schema field docs in outputs.rs or the briefs rendered by briefs.rs) or to remove text of equal size. Show the remaining budget per prompt set in the reader's context. Acceptance: (1) a reading that adds text to a set with too little room is refused before the producer starts; (2) a reading that fits, or that removes at least as much as it adds, passes; (3) a test covers both cases with the reader set at 1997 of 2000 tokens; (4) the budgets test still passes on the landed change.
